text:
sam_sales: MerchantOne finalizing commit. They expect sustained 5k RPS during promo windows, short 2x bursts (~10m), and 200ms p95. Asking for reserved GPU slab + burst-credit pricing and exact failure/fallback language for the SOW. Can eng confirm sizing and autoscale recommendations?

ella_sre: Quick clarifier  average response tokens and % rerank?

sam_sales: Avg response ~360 tokens, rerank ~6%. Mostly single-turn generation.

roz_prod: With seq ~360 and a batching cap to keep p95 under 200ms (queue cap ~25ms), realistic throughput ~800 RPS per A100-equivalent GPU. For steady 5k RPS we should size to 7 reserved GPUs. KV/prefix caching gives ~20-25% uplift once warm.

ben_infra: For 2x bursts add a burst pool 4-6 GPUs. Spot-backed is cost-efficient but has eviction risk. Two customer profiles to offer: (1) spot-burst credits + documented quantized fallback, (2) premium reserved-burst with stronger SLA.

 tala_se: Autoscale proposal: monitor 30s RPS moving average, scale up when >85% of reserved for 60s, cooldown 120s. Allow burst pool until configured max. If burst not available within 120s, automated fallback to quantized-8bit variant; continued constraint -> 429s for excess requests. Webhook notifications for customers.

ella_sre: Operational notes: preheat KV 10 minutes before known campaigns. Avoid scaling into cold KV. Recommend preheat API runbook and a scheduled job.

ben_infra: Preheat example for runbook: `curl -X POST https://ops.redwood.example/v1/preheat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"job":"kv_warm","model":"merchant-chat-v1","start_in":"10m","duration_mins":15}'`

roz_prod: Contract matrix suggestion: baseline (fp32), fallback (8-bit quantized), degraded (smaller model). Include deterministic perf numbers per variant to prevent disputes.

tala_se: Security checklist: CMEK/KMS supported for Private, VPC peering available, audit logs exportable (S3/SIEM). SOC2 addendum ETA ~5 business days from legal. No technical blockers.

sam_sales: Legal wants SLA paragraph wording for burst failure. Can someone draft short text we can paste into MSA?

ella_sre: Draft SLA blurb: "Reserved capacity is provisioned per schedule. Burst credits are best-effort; if burst capacity cannot be provisioned within 120 seconds, Redwood will attempt an automated fallback to a quantized model variant. If capacity remains constrained, excess requests may receive HTTP 429 responses and customer remedies will follow the credit schedule in the contract."

ben_infra: Runbook steps: detect surge -> check KV hit-rate -> if cold start preheat -> if eviction occurs route to quantized fallback -> open incident and notify customer webhook. Add playbook links.

roz_prod: I'll produce a conservative perf table: rps/GPU at seq250/350/450, p95 numbers, and quantized throughput deltas. Deliver by EOD tomorrow.

tala_se: I'll draft security onboarding checklist and confirm SOC2 timeline.

sam_sales: Great. Action items captured: perf table, runbook + preheat snippet, security checklist + SOC2 ETA, and SLA paragraph. I'll bundle for finance/legal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: Reminder: Dedicated provisioning requires RFC ticket and AZ affinity details. Link: https://rfd.redwood.example/requests/11011
